narrative.overview: CCF is a light, premium agency workflow. White space gives the campaign and its next accountable decision room to breathe; violet makes collaboration visible; orange punctuates the action. The public story has an editorial pace and an illustrative product window, while working surfaces are quieter, denser, and organised around real handoffs. Stitch.money is a reference for palette cohesion and lightness, not an asset library or a screen to copy. The CCF name, logo, campaign language, and role-specific workflow remain its own.
keyCharacteristics: White content surfaces and a pale neutral canvas.
Dark ink for headings and decisions; restrained orange for the main action.
Violet collaboration moments with a related lavender tint.
Generous editorial spacing in the public story; line-based scanability in the desk.
Intentional, stacked mobile composition rather than scaled-down desktop panels.

rules.name: The One Decision Rule
rules.body: Orange identifies the primary move or current stage; it is not a large background or a long-form text colour.

rules.name: The Collaboration Rule
rules.body: Use violet and its HSL-derived lavender for shared context, selected state, and focus; preserve the white working surface.

rules.name: The Clear Handoff Rule
rules.body: Set the next action in strong, readable type; subordinate metadata without making it low contrast.

rules.name: The Next Decision Rule
rules.body: Working screens begin with the present handoff and owner, not decorative totals.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: In the operating UI, state and hierarchy come from type, spacing, border, and tint before shadow.

dos: Do keep content white and use the canvas or lavender tint to separate meaningfully different contexts.
Do make the campaign, next owner, and next action scannable before supporting detail.
Do keep sample and manually entered information explicitly labelled.
Do give mobile its own reading order and full-width actions where space requires it.
Do keep focus visible and remove decorative motion under reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't make orange a general surface fill or violet a replacement for readable ink body copy.
Don't add dark dashboard panels, heavy working-screen shadows, or invented KPI totals to create visual interest.
Don't imply a sample sends notifications, moves money, or verifies platform metrics.
Don't mix creator-private finances into the shared agency campaign record.
